deed: יואב בנימיני ויוסף הוכברג פיתחו שיטה שמסננת תגליות שווא במדע
title: Yoav Benjamini and Yosef Hochberg presented the FDR, a method that filters out false discoveries in science

trailer.text: Yoav Benjamini, who was born in Israel, is a professor emeritus in the Department of Statistics at Tel Aviv University and a recipient of the Israel Prize.

Together with the late Prof. Yosef Hochberg, he first presented the false discovery rate (FDR), a new way to find as many true discoveries as possible while keeping the rate of errors among them in check.
The paper was written at Tel Aviv University. At the time, it conflicted with the accepted criteria, and consequently its publication was delayed for years.
Today it is one of the most highly cited papers in the scientific world.
In 2024 Benjamini and his former students, Daniel Yekutieli and Ruth Heller, won the Rousseeuw Prize for Statistics, worth one million dollars.

glance.label: Impact
glance.value: Among the most cited papers in science

stations.title: The problem: too many tests, too many "discoveries"

paragraphs.text: According to Benjamini, the idea was born from a need in medical research, in studies that examine large numbers of success parameters to evaluate new treatments.
According to the paper, studies that examined reports of comparative studies in major medical journals found that researchers overlook various kinds of multiplicity.
As a result, according to the paper, reporting tends to exaggerate differences between treatments.
According to the paper, the common approach to the problem called for controlling the familywise error rate (FWER), and this approach has faults.

When high-throughput technologies (such as genomics and microarrays) became widespread, researchers collected data with small samples and many variables, and in these data too few variables were found significant after classic correction for multiple tests. This is the accepted explanation for today's widespread use of FDR.
The paper also gives an example from the world of medicines: screening of various chemicals for drug development.

stations.title: The idea: controlling the rate of errors among the discoveries

paragraphs.text: Benjamini and Hochberg first presented a new criterion, the false discovery rate (FDR).
The idea is to control the expected proportion of errors among the rejected hypotheses.
They expressed the criterion mathematically and proposed a method for finding a maximum number of discoveries while maintaining a desirable FDR.
They adopted the term after Soric (1989), who identified a rejected hypothesis with a "statistical discovery".
According to Wikipedia, Soric's work led them to the idea that such an error rate can serve as a goal to control, and not merely a warning.
The paper was written at Tel Aviv University in Israel.
The paper clashed with the criteria that prevailed at the time, and consequently its publication was delayed for years.
According to the Israel Prize committee's citation, the new approach met with suspicion in its early days.
The paper reached the journal's editorial office in January 1993, and a revised version of it was submitted in March 1994.
It was published in 1995.

stations.title: The test: heart patients and a simulation

paragraphs.text: As an example, the paper examines a randomized multicentre trial in 421 patients with acute myocardial infarction.
The classic Bonferroni method, at level 0.05, rejected only three hypotheses.
According to the paper, from the classical point of view it would not have been justified to declare a significant reduction in mortality.
With the FDR method four hypotheses were rejected, among them the hypothesis about a reduction in mortality.
The authors also tested the method in a large simulation.
According to the results, the power of the method was uniformly larger than that of the other methods.

As an example of a situation in which the advantage is especially large, the paper gives a test of 32 hypotheses, none of which is true, spread equally in four clusters between 1.25 and 5. In this configuration the power of Bonferroni was 0.42, and the new method raised it to 0.65.
In some situations, up to half of the non-null hypotheses that Bonferroni did not reject were rejected by the FDR method.
Their conclusion: the cost of controlling multiplicity need not be large.
Today the paper is one of the most highly cited papers in the scientific world.
In 2005 it was identified as one of the 25 most-cited statistical papers.
According to Wikipedia, the FDR was the first alternative to the FWER to gain broad acceptance in many scientific fields.
According to the Israel Prize committee, the approach changed the way problems with a large number of hypotheses are examined.
According to Benjamini, many fields share a need to scan enormous quantities of possible results and find real discoveries in mountains of data.
The technology of microarrays, for example, enabled thousands of genes to be tested simultaneously.
According to him, FDR methods are applied today in diverse fields, among them genomics.
Benjamini writes that the results of studies gaining headlines often cannot be replicated by other researchers.
According to him, part of the problem is statistical tools that fail to address the challenge of selective inference.
His former students, Yekutieli and Heller, extended the method to genomics and neuroscience, and proposed ways to assess the reproducibility of findings.
The Benjamini–Yekutieli procedure controls the false discovery rate even under arbitrary dependence assumptions.

stations.title: Recognition: from the Israel Prize to the Rousseeuw Prize

paragraphs.text: In 2012 Benjamini won the Israel Prize in Economics and Statistics research.
He is also a recipient of the Karl Pearson Prize of the International Statistical Institute.
In 2015 he was elected to the Israel Academy of Sciences and Humanities, and in 2020 to the National Academy of Sciences of the United States.
In 2024 Benjamini, Yekutieli and Heller won the Rousseeuw Prize for Statistics.
The prize is awarded by the King Baudouin Foundation in Belgium, which appoints the international jury.
The prize was established in 2022 as an equivalent of the Nobel Prize, which does not include mathematical disciplines.
It includes a medal, a certificate and one million dollars.
According to Benjamini, the prize was given for introducing the FDR with the late Hochberg and for the expansions with Yekutieli and Heller.
The ceremony was held at the Catholic University of Leuven, where protests by students and faculty members called for a full academic boycott of Israeli universities.
Outside the building, students distributed flyers calling for a comprehensive boycott.
In his speech Benjamini called for preserving scientific collaborations, avoiding boycotts and protecting science from political interference.
He also told of the brutal kidnapping and murder of Carmel Gat, a family friend.
Yoav Benjamini was born in Israel on 5 January 1949, to Yosef and Tova.
He studied at the Hebrew Reali School in Haifa, and completed a bachelor's degree in physics and mathematics and a master's degree in mathematics at the Hebrew University.
In 1981 he joined the Department of Statistics and Operations Research at Tel Aviv University, and in 2000 he was promoted to full professor.
His partner in the idea was the late Prof. Yosef Hochberg.
Benjamini said that winning the Rousseeuw Prize is the outcome of a long process, planted and cultivated in Israel for many years.
He said that he hopes that even in the difficult times for Israel and the region, societies will allow academia to sustain an open and healthy environment.

stations.title: What the method does not guarantee

paragraphs.text: FDR procedures control Type I errors less stringently than FWER procedures.
The Benjamini–Hochberg procedure controls the FDR only under certain conditions, such as independent test statistics.

claims.quote: The Benjamini–Yekutieli procedure controls the false discovery rate under arbitrary dependence assumptions.

claims.text: ביוני 2015 נבחר בנימיני לחבר באקדמיה הלאומית הישראלית למדעים.
claims.quote: ביוני 2015 נבחר כחבר באקדמיה הלאומית הישראלית למדעים.

claims.text: ב-2020 נבחר בנימיני לחבר באקדמיה הלאומית למדעים של ארצות הברית.
claims.quote: ב-2020 נבחר כחבר באקדמיה הלאומית למדעים בארצות הברית.

claims.text: מוסד הבית של הפרס הוא קרן המלך בודואן בבלגיה, שממנה את חבר השופטים הבינלאומי ומבצעת את הליך הבחירה.
claims.quote: The home institution of the prize, initiated two years ago, is the King Baudouin Foundation in Belgium, which appoints the international jury and carries out the selection procedure.

claims.text: הפרס, בסך מיליון דולר, נוסד כמקבילה לפרס נובל, שאינו כולל תחומים מתמטיים.
claims.quote: The $1 million prize, established as an equivalent of the Nobel Prize which does not include mathematical disciplines

claims.text: פרס רוסו ניתן אחת לשנתיים בשנים זוגיות וכולל מדליה, תעודה ופרס כספי של מיליון דולר.
claims.quote: This prize is awarded in even years, and includes a medal, a certificate, and a monetary reward of $1,000,000, similar to the Nobel Prize in other disciplines.

claims.text: הטקס נערך באוניברסיטה הקתולית של לבן, שבה מחאות של סטודנטים וחברי סגל קראו לחרם אקדמי מלא על אוניברסיטאות ישראליות.
claims.quote: The ceremony was held at the Catholic University of Leuven, where protests by students and faculty members have called for a full academic boycott of Israeli universities.

claims.text: מחוץ לבניין הטקס חילקו סטודנטים עלונים הקוראים לחרם מקיף.
claims.quote: Outside the building where the ceremony took place, students distributed flyers advocating for a comprehensive boycott

claims.text: בנאומו בטקס קרא בנימיני לשמור על שיתופי פעולה מדעיים, להימנע מחרמות ולהגן על המדע מהתערבות פוליטית.
claims.quote: He called for the preservation of scientific collaborations, avoidance of boycotts, and protection of science from political interference.

claims.text: בנאומו סיפר בנימיני על החטיפה והרצח האכזריים של כרמל גת, ידידת המשפחה.
claims.quote: He also shared the story of the brutal kidnapping and murder of family friend Carmel Gat

claims.text: בנימיני סיים תואר ראשון בפיזיקה ומתמטיקה ותואר שני במתמטיקה באוניברסיטה העברית.
claims.quote: סיים תואר ראשון בפיזיקה ומתמטיקה ותואר שני במתמטיקה באוניברסיטה העברית.

claims.text: ב-1981 הצטרף לחוג לסטטיסטיקה וחקר ביצועים באוניברסיטת תל אביב, וב-2000 קודם לפרופסור מן המניין.
claims.quote: ב-1981 הצטרף לסגל החוג לסטטיסטיקה וחקר ביצועים באוניברסיטת תל אביב, וב-2000 קודם לפרופסור מן המניין.

claims.text: בנימיני אמר שהזכייה בפרס רוסו היא פרי תהליך ארוך שנזרע וטופח בישראל שנים רבות.
claims.quote: Winning the Rousseeuw Prize is the outcome of a long process, planted and cultivated in Israel for many years, in a fertile academic substrate

claims.text: בנימיני אמר שהוא מקווה שגם בימים הקשים לישראל ולאזור החברות יאפשרו לאקדמיה לשמור על סביבה פתוחה ובריאה.
claims.quote: I hope that even in these difficult times for Israel and the region, our societies will allow academia to sustain an open and healthy environment

claims.text: נהלי שליטה ב-FDR מספקים שליטה פחות מחמירה בשגיאות מסוג I מנהלי FWER.
claims.quote: FDR-controlling procedures provide less stringent control of Type I errors compared to family-wise error rate (FWER) controlling procedures

claims.text: נוהל בנימיני-הוכברג שולט ב-FDR ברמה α בתנאים מסוימים, כגון סטטיסטיקות מבחן בלתי תלויות.
claims.quote: The Benjamini–Hochberg procedure (BH step-up procedure) controls the FDR at level α under certain conditions, such as independent test statistics.

claims.text: לפי תקציר המאמר, נוהל פשוט מסוג בונפרוני רציף הוכח כשולט ב-FDR עבור סטטיסטיקות מבחן בלתי תלויות, וניסוי סימולציה מראה שהרווח בעוצמה משמעותי.
claims.quote: A simple sequential Bonferroni- type procedure is proved to control the false discovery rate for independent test statistics, and a simulation study shows that the gain in power is substantial.

claims.text: ב-3 בדצמבר העניקה קרן המלך בודואן בבלגיה את פרס רוסו לבנימיני ולעמיתיו.
claims.quote: On Dec. 3 the King Baudouin Foundation in Belgium awarded the prestigious Rousseeuw Prize in Statistics to Prof. Yoav Benjamini

claims.text: מרכז אדמונד י. ספרא בדיווח באוגוסט 2024 מסר שבנימיני, יקותיאלי והלר זכו בפרס רוסו 2024 לסטטיסטיקה.

quote_translations.c39: Yoav Benjamini (born 5 January 1949) is a professor emeritus in the Department of Statistics at the School of Mathematical Sciences at Tel Aviv University
quote_translations.c40: Benjamini was born in Israel, to Yosef and Tova. He studied at the Hebrew Reali School in Haifa
quote_translations.c44: The method was published as a scientific paper in 1995, which was later ranked as one of the 25 most cited papers in statistics.
quote_translations.c47: In 2012 he won the Israel Prize in Economics and Statistics research. In its citation the prize committee wrote:
quote_translations.c50: In 2024 he won (together with Professors Daniel Yekutieli and Ruth Heller) the Rousseeuw Prize for Statistics for work that makes it possible to scan a large number of experimental results and sort out of them real discoveries.
quote_translations.c43: Benjamini is known especially for developing the false discovery rate method in 1989, together with Prof. Yosef Hochberg, which is used for testing multiple hypotheses.
quote_translations.c45: This innovative approach, which met with suspicion in its early days, became a highly accepted method for analyzing complex hypotheses in broad fields of science.
quote_translations.c46: This approach changed the way in which problems are examined that require statistical examination of a large number of hypotheses.
quote_translations.c48: In June 2015 he was elected as a member of the Israel Academy of Sciences and Humanities.
quote_translations.c49: In 2020 he was elected as a member of the National Academy of Sciences in the United States.
quote_translations.c41: He completed a bachelor's degree in physics and mathematics and a master's degree in mathematics at the Hebrew University.
quote_translations.c42: In 1981 he joined the faculty of the Department of Statistics and Operations Research at Tel Aviv University, and in 2000 he was promoted to full professor.
